A LACCICO shoelace is the high-quality accessory

that underlines the aesthetics of your shoe.

image.alt: LACCICO – The architecture of the braid

text.htmlDescription:
As a shoemaking craft business, we know exactly what matters: our selection is based on the expertise of long-established specialists who bring the art of braiding to perfection on specialised braiding machines. The characterful elegance of our laces comes directly from the high density and the tight braid, which fully meets our high standards of craftsmanship.

Material & construction: The solid substance of our range is the direct result of a compact braid. The key is the careful matching of the number of bobbins and the yarn thickness to the specific requirements of our different shoelaces – from fine round laces to striking, wide flat laces. This gives every model a tear-resistant, shape-retaining and durable result.

Refined by traditional waxing: The quality of our shoelaces does not come from a mere coating, but from the time-honoured method of making cords last: traditional waxing, in which the wax fully penetrates the fibre structure of the braid. This makes the braid water-repellent, abrasion-resistant and dirt-resistant.

Feel: Enjoy smooth running through the eyelets combined with a good grip. Our XR (Xtra Robust) models offer a soft yet solid volume, achieved through a particularly high, model-specific yarn density and careful production.

References: stylish connections

The quality of a shoe shows in its details.

LACCICO shoelaces are the fitting complement to Goodyear-welted classics and exclusive footwear. Our careful selection ensures that the material always meets the high demands on appearance and function. A shoe with character calls for a lace that shares its quality. Our silky-sheen surfaces go perfectly with fine upper leather and create a striking, timeless overall look that underlines the aesthetics of the shoemaker's craft.

This visual harmony is made possible by the wide range of diameters from R2 to R3 and widths from F3 to F6, so that we have the right accessory for every eyelet arrangement. The shape-retaining braid does not stretch out, even with daily use. Only when the width of the lace is matched to the proportions of the shoe does that authentic elegance arise which connoisseurs of fine footwear have always appreciated.

A LACCICO lace keeps its shape – for a confident feeling all day long. In addition, the tear resistance achieved by the tight braid is convincing. The high-quality appearance lasts a long time, as the traditional waxing protects the material. Anyone who values details will find in our products the certainty that function and style form an inseparable unit that rounds off the character of the shoe in a worthy way.

What lasts long needs replacing less often. As a craft business, we choose shoelaces that will accompany your shoe reliably: 100 % cotton, braided to be tear-resistant and waxed. The wax penetrates the braid and protects the fibre against moisture and abrasion.

A piece of craftsmanship on your shoe. Waxed cotton laces have always belonged to the classic leather shoe. Their braid and their silky-matt sheen suit fine leather, as shoemakers have worked it for generations.

Honest in material. We rely on pure cotton without fillers. What the lace can withstand, it owes to the braid and the waxing.

Care that pays off. If a lace becomes dull over time, it is easy to refresh: wrap a cloth with a little shoe cream firmly around the lace and pull it along firmly, so the wax is redistributed. Now and then, unthread the lace completely so that the hidden parts get some too.
